overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the appointment was not anticipated by the chair 48 hours before the December 19, 2022 meeting, and the Board amended its notice to list it, so discussing and voting on it was permitted.

allegations.summary: Alleged the Board discussed and voted on a committee appointment that was not listed on the December 19, 2022 meeting notice.
allegations.key_passage: However, we do not find a violation of the Open Meeting Law because a public body may discuss a topic not listed on a meeting notice if the topic was not anticipated by the chair 48 hours in advance of the meeting.
